label: SARS-CoV-2 reinfection: a possible contributing factor to long COVID in children and adolescents.
summary: Following the end of the COVID-19 pandemic, attention shifted towards patients who developed sequelae, persistent symptoms, or relapsing or remitting symptoms of new conditions after a prior history of acute SARS-CoV-2 infection. The objective of the present study was to identify the prevalence, clinical characteristics, and potential associated factors of long COVID in children treated during the pandemic in a primary care unit.
